categories_child_name_idx.name: categories_child_name_idx
categories_child_name_idx.where: "categories"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "categories"."deleted_at" IS NULL

contacts_fields_check.name: contacts_fields_check
contacts_fields_check.value: char_length(btrim("contacts"."name")) between 1 and 100 AND char_length("contacts"."phone") <= 100 AND char_length("contacts"."email") <= 254 AND char_length("contacts"."note") <= 2000

receivables_fields_check.name: receivables_fields_check
receivables_fields_check.value: char_length(btrim("receivables"."description")) between 1 and 2000 AND char_length("receivables"."write_off_reason") <= 2000 AND "receivables"."service_date" between date '0001-01-01' and date '9999-12-31' AND ("receivables"."due_date" IS NULL OR "receivables"."due_date" between date '0001-01-01' and date '9999-12-31')

receivables_waiver_check.name: receivables_waiver_check
receivables_waiver_check.value: ("receivables"."written_off_at" IS NULL AND "receivables"."written_off_amount" IS NULL AND "receivables"."write_off_reason" IS NULL) OR ("receivables"."written_off_at" IS NOT NULL AND "receivables"."written_off_amount" between 1 and "receivables"."amount")

transactions_payment_check.name: transactions_payment_check
transactions_payment_check.value: ("transactions"."receivable_payment_id" IS NULL AND "transactions"."receivable_id" IS NULL) OR ("transactions"."receivable_payment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."receivable_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."kind"='income' AND "transactions"."status"='cleared' AND NOT "transactions"."is_split" AND "transactions"."transfer_id" IS NULL)

transactions_transfer_check.name: transactions_transfer_check
transactions_transfer_check.value: ("transactions"."kind" = 'transfer' AND "transactions"."transfer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."category_id" IS NULL AND "transactions"."status" = 'cleared' AND "transactions"."payee" IS NULL AND NOT "transactions"."is_split") OR ("transactions"."kind" IN ('expense', 'income') AND "transactions"."transfer_id" IS NULL AND (("transactions"."is_split" AND "transactions"."category_id" IS NULL) OR (NOT "transactions"."is_split" AND "transactions"."category_id" IS NOT NULL)))
